title: dispatch gives a host worker only the scratch directory, so it cannot read the plugin's role file its brief names (second-project run)
goal: A worker dispatch starts for a project whose role file is the plugin's agents/worker.md can read that file: dispatch adds the plugin root to the session's --add-dir when the brief names the plugin's role file, with no setting the host must add

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import inspect, bl_dispatch as d; sys.exit(0 if 'PLUGIN_ROOT' in inspect.getsource(d.claude_argv) else 1)

repro_reason: the read is refused only in a host project's headless session; the run's result.json holds the denial
notes: Run finding 10: the worker exited 0 with no commit, result.json permission_denials: [{tool_name: Read, file_path: <plugin>/agents/worker.md}]; fixed for the run only by the host's .claude/settings.json permissions.additionalDirectories naming the plugin root.
